description.value: Holiday Motel & RV Resort is a family-oriented property in Hope, BC offering 16 motel units, 4 cabins, 14 RV sites, and 4 tent sites on spacious resort grounds complete with a seasonal heated pool, campfire pits, and a children's playground. The property has a quirky distinction as a filming location for multiple movies and television shows over the years. Conveniently positioned near Kawkawa Lake and Coquihalla Canyon Provincial Park, it serves as a practical overnight base for cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley.

address.value: 63950 Old Yale Road, Hope, BC V0X 1L2
